title: Private Group Breathwork Experience in Lake Tahoe
includes: Use of yoga mat, blanket, eye covering
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Not recommended for people with severe or uncontrolled high blood pressure
Not recommended for people diagnosed with bipolar disorder, schizophrenia, psychosis, or severe psychiatric conditions
Not recommended for people with severe asthma or respiratory conditions
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This Lake Tahoe breathwork experience offers a rare way to gather — slowing down together in a place known for its natural power and beauty. Designed for private groups, each journey is intentionally shaped around your people, your energy, and the reason you’re coming together. The combination of breath, shared rhythm, and Tahoe’s grounding landscape creates a sense of connection that’s hard to replicate elsewhere. It’s both expansive and intimate — equal parts personal insight and collective presence. Whether you’re celebrating, reconnecting, or simply looking for something meaningful to share, this experience leaves groups feeling more connected, refreshed, and deeply rooted in the moment
